answer: No fresh key can harbor a grading history it never earned. Weight comes only from quorum-matched verdicts sealed on-ledger and re-checked against consensus, a record as hard to forge as a relic is to counterfeit and as slow to hollow out as a karst. A thousand clones share none of it; each must grade its own way up over epochs, so the sybil bill rises linearly in identities and never amortizes.
